haj.pageDescription: Discover comprehensive Hajj packages with QuickAir. A sacred spiritual journey to Makkah and Madinah

haj.intro2: We offer comprehensive Hajj packages that ensure a comfortable and spiritual journey, with a dedicated team to accompany you every step of the way.

hero.title: Umrah
hero.subtitle: A Confirmed Sunnah - An opportunity to draw closer to Allah and renew faith

about.title: The Spiritual Umrah Journey
about.paragraph1: Umrah is a pilgrimage to Makkah that can be undertaken at any time of the year. It is a confirmed Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and holds great spiritual significance in Islam.
about.paragraph2: The Prophet (PBUH) said: 'The performance of Umrah is an expiation for the sins committed between it and the previous Umrah.' We offer comprehensive Umrah packages to help you embark on this blessed journey.

steps.title: Umrah Steps
steps.subtitle: Umrah Rituals
steps.description: Learn about the essential steps of performing Umrah

ihram.title: Ihram
ihram.description: Enter the state of Ihram at the Miqat, wearing the prescribed garments and making the intention for Umrah

tawaf.title: Tawaf
tawaf.description: Circumambulate the Kaaba seven times in an anti-clockwise direction, starting from the Black Stone

sai.title: Sa'i
sai.description: Walk between the hills of Safa and Marwa seven times, commemorating Hajar's search for water

halq.title: Halq/Taqsir
halq.description: Shave the head (Halq) or trim the hair (Taqsir) to complete the Umrah rituals

inclusions.title: Program Includes
items: Accommodation in the mentioned hotels or similar of the same category

items: International airfare tickets (EgyptAir or Saudi Airlines)

exchangeRate.title: Exchange Rate
exchangeRate.note: Any increase in the Saudi Riyal exchange rate will be added to the program price

roomPolicy.description: All triple and quad rooms are double rooms with an extra bed. All advertised prices are for non-view rooms.
